propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time when own_material differs, wasting checkpoint I/O and billing for all intermediate work
The cancel predicate must scope to own_material only (excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision) to avoid false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes
The cancel signal must be checked before gate_dispatch's coach/verify recovery paths to prevent a cancel from being recovered into a findings verdict and flowing to signing
The probe must perform a single-ticket light read (attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context) without fetch/reconverge or store-wide reduction to avoid contention

When own_material changes at either the verify-inputs or coach-inputs seam, the review must return an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and exit code 2, skipping all downstream steps and sidecar emission
